message.content:
Below is a quick‑look list of the **long weekends** that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a public holiday that falls on a weekday and is surrounded by at least one weekend day, giving you a stretch of three or more consecutive days off.)

| Holiday | Date in 2023 | Weekend Days Included | Notes |
|---------|--------------|-----------------------|-------|
| **New Year’s Day** (observed) | Jan 2 (Mon) | Jan 1 (Sun) – Jan 3 (Mon) | New Year’s Day fell on Sunday, so it was observed on Monday. |
| **Family Day** (Alberta, BC, NB, ON, PEI, SK) | Feb 20 (Mon) | Feb 18 (Fri) – Feb 20 (Mon) | Observed in several provinces; gives a 3‑day break. |
| **Good Friday** | Apr 7 (Fri) | Apr 7 (Fri) – Apr 9 (Sun) | Religious holiday; many provinces observe it. |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 (Mon) | May 20 (Fri) – May 22 (Mon) | Celebrates Queen Victoria’s birthday; a federal holiday. |
| **Canada Day** (observed) | Jul 3 (Mon) | Jun 30 (Fri) – Jul 3 (Mon) | Canada Day fell on Saturday, so it was observed on Monday. |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 (Mon) | Sep 2 (Fri) – Sep 4 (Mon) | National holiday marking the end of summer. |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 (Mon) | Oct 7 (Fri) – Oct 9 (Mon) | Harvest festival; a federal holiday. |
| **Christmas Day** | Dec 25 (Mon) | Dec 23 (Fri) – Dec 25 (Mon) | Major holiday; gives a 3‑day break. |

### How to use this in your app
1. **Store the dates** in a database or JSON file.  
2. **Flag the weekend days** (e.g., Jan 1, Jan 3, etc.) as “public holiday” so users can see the full stretch.  
3. **Add a reminder** feature that alerts users a few days before each long weekend.

If you need the exact dates for other provinces (e.g., Family Day in Ontario vs. British Columbia) or want to include provincial holidays that create additional long weekends, let me know and I can expand the list!
